# Main Street Toolbox

> Free calculators for small service businesses — restaurants, cleaning companies, lawn care crews, contractors, salons and retail shops. US pricing benchmarks, instant results, no signup.

## Docs

- [Home](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/): Overview of all 26 free tools with a live search box; the fastest way to find the right calculator.
- [All Tools](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/tools/): Every calculator grouped by trade with one-line descriptions of what each answers.
- [Restaurant tools](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/restaurant/): Food cost, menu pricing, menu engineering, tip out, prime cost and labor calculators for restaurant owners.
- [Cleaning tools](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/cleaning/): House cleaning estimates, pressure washing and window cleaning pricing, junk removal, invoices and checklists.
- [Construction tools](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/construction/): Contractor hourly rates, material cost estimates and printable work orders.
- [Lawn care tools](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/lawn/): Mowing prices, full lawn-care estimates and a mulch quantity calculator.
- [Salon tools](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/salon/): Service price list builder, booth rent vs commission calculator and receipt generator.
- [Retail tools](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/retail/): Retail math, markup, discount profit and inventory count tools for independent shops.

## Tools

- [Menu Maker](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/menu-maker/): Design a printable restaurant menu from templates; export as PDF or PNG.
- [Food Cost Percentage Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/restaurant/food-cost-percentage-calculator/): Enter plate cost and menu price; returns food cost percentage against the 28–35% healthy band and the price that fixes a high number.
- [Menu Pricing Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/restaurant/menu-pricing-calculator/): Set menu prices from target food cost percentage per dish.
- [Menu Engineering Matrix](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/restaurant/menu-engineering-matrix/): Scores every dish on profitability and popularity; classifies Stars, Plowhorses, Puzzles and Dogs with an action per class.
- [Tip Out Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/restaurant/tip-out-calculator/): Splits the tip pool across servers and support staff by percentage shares; printable summary sheet.
- [Prime Cost Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/restaurant/prime-cost-calculator/): Combines food cost plus labor cost as a share of sales — the number that decides if a restaurant is viable.
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/restaurant/break-even-calculator/): Sales volume needed to cover fixed and variable costs for a restaurant.
- [House Cleaning Cost Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/cleaning/cleaning-estimate-calculator/): Prices standard, deep and move-out cleans by bedrooms and bathrooms against 2026 US ranges.
- [Pressure Washing Price Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/cleaning/pressure-washing-price-calculator/): Prices pressure washing jobs by surface type and square footage with per-sqft US benchmarks.
- [Window Cleaning Price Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/cleaning/window-cleaning-price-calculator/): Prices window cleaning per pane or per job for residential and small commercial work.
- [Junk Removal Estimator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/cleaning/junk-removal-estimator/): Estimates junk removal pricing by truck-load fractions, the way operators actually quote.
- [Cleaning Invoice Generator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/cleaning/cleaning-invoice-generator/): Creates a cleaning-industry invoice with line items and payment terms; printable PDF.
- [Contractor Hourly Rate Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/construction/contractor-hourly-rate-calculator/): The hourly rate a contractor must charge to cover wages, taxes, overhead and target profit — includes handyman and state variations.
- [Lawn Mowing Price Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/lawn/lawn-mowing-price-calculator/): Prices mowing jobs by lawn size, frequency and trim work against US averages.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/lawn/mulch-calculator/): Cubic yards of mulch needed for an area and depth, with bag-count conversion.
- [Snow Removal Pricing Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/lawn/snow-removal-pricing-calculator/): Prices snow removal per push by driveway size, as a seasonal contract or hourly — with 2026 US ranges and contract trigger-depth guidance.
- [Service Price List Builder](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/salon/service-price-list-builder/): Builds a typeset, printable price list for any service business — salon, cleaning, lawn care or contracting.
- [Retail Math Calculator](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/retail/retail-math-calculator/): Markup, margin, markdown, sell-through, GMROI and break-even modules with a printable cheat sheet.

## Guides

- [Food Cost Percentage: Complete Guide](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/guides/food-cost-percentage/): How restaurant food cost percentage works, healthy ranges by service type, and how to fix a high number.
- [House Cleaning Prices Guide](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/guides/house-cleaning-prices/): What cleaning companies charge across US markets by home size and clean type, and how to quote.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning Rates](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/guides/post-construction-cleaning-rates/): How to price post-construction cleaning — per sqft ranges, scope checklists and bid structure.
- [Cleaning Invoice Template Guide](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/guides/cleaning-invoice-template/): What a cleaning invoice must include, with a free generator and payment-term conventions.
- [Booth Rent vs Commission](https://mainstreettoolbox.com/guides/booth-rent-vs-commission/): How salons and stylists compare booth rental against commission pay structures, with break-even numbers.

## Key Facts

- 26 free tools across 6 trades: restaurant, cleaning, construction, lawn care, salon and retail
- US pricing benchmarks throughout; target market is United States small businesses
- Every tool works instantly with no signup, no account and no ads
- Independent, single-developer project; pricing benchmarks sourced from industry data and cross-checked guides
- Supported voluntary via Ko-fi; core tools stay free
